items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yeah, but I didn't know him before that time.

ctx.x: Remember him hearing Baby Dodds down here?
No, I never heard Baby down here. I heard him down here after George went to New York with George. Yeah, but I didn't know him before that time.
Remember any other real old timers like Louis Cantrell or Cantrell? Yeah, Louis Cantrell, yeah.
